description: 100-update fault-only binary Sign-advantage training on Qwen3-4B

protocol.actual_updates_note: Both seeds stopped at U80 due to vLLM EngineCore crashes. Seed 42: crash on resume attempt. Seed 137: crash during continuous training at U80->U81. Cosine LR had decayed to ~2-4e-6 by U73-U80, so remaining updates would have had minimal impact.

primary_gate.rule: best of U20/U50/U80, both seeds individually

key_observations: Both seeds pass primary and guardrail gates individually — R3c succeeds.
Seed 137 peaked earlier (U50) and higher (78.75%) than seed 42 (U80, 71.25%).
Normal-task performance improved or held at all passing checkpoints (no regression).
Sign advantage (A=2r-1) eliminated the zero-gradient problem that stalled R3's GRPO on binary rewards.
vLLM EngineCore crash at ~U80 appears systematic — both seeds hit it, possibly GPU memory fragmentation over ~80 layered_summon cycles.

estimated_cost_cny.note: Approximate, based on AutoDL RTX 4090 hourly rate
